data.long_meaning: Bringing blessings and good fortune, indicative of success and prosperity. The name Shubash is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘shubh’ which means auspicious or propitious. The name is a sign of God's grace and blessings, and is believed to bring prosperity and success to the bearer. The name Shubash carries the meaning “Auspicious, Propitious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shubash usually hope their child will grow to embody auspicious, propitious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
